quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #7
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Road construction ahead.
The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down and be ready for these curves.

questions.question: Safe interstate driving requires you to:

options.text: Be able to safely drive at higher speeds.
Stay alert at all times.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: Interstate driving is safe only when you stay alert and can drive at higher speeds.

questions.question: If your tire blows out, you should:

options.text: Remove your foot from the gas pedal.
Not brake immediately.
Slowly reduce speed and pull to the side of the road.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: If your tire blows out, take your foot off the gas. Do not brake right away. Slowly reduce your speed, then gently apply the brakes and pull to the side of the road.

questions.question: When sharing the road with trucks, remember that trucks generally:

options.text: Need longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles.
Need less time to pass going downhill than smaller vehicles.
Can turn in a smaller space than smaller vehicles.
Need less time to pass going uphill than smaller vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Need longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles.
questions.explanation: Trucks are large and heavy. They need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light at an intersection, you must:

options.text: Stop completely, let traffic and pedestrians pass, then go.
Slow down and proceed carefully.
Stop completely and wait until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, let traffic and pedestrians pass, then go.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, let oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No U-turn.
No left turn.
No right turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Turning right here is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: To see better in rain or fog, drivers should use:

options.text: Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
Parking lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in rain or fog. Low beams help others see you, even if they do not help you see much better.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches, you must:

options.text: Keep your speed and stay in your lane until it passes.
Move to the right lane and drive slowly until it passes.
Pull to the side of the road and stop until it passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the side of the road and stop until it passes.
questions.explanation: Pull to the right edge of the road and stop. Park parallel to the curb. On one-way streets, move to whichever edge is closest to you.

questions.question: On a green arrow, you must:

options.text: Yield to any cars, bicycles, or pedestrians in the intersection.
Yield to pedestrians only in the intersection.
Wait four seconds before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to any cars, bicycles, or pedestrians in the intersection.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go. Turn in the direction the arrow points. First, yield to any cars, bicycles, or pedestrians still in the intersection.

questions.question: When riding in a vehicle, small children:

options.text: Can be safely held by an adult.
Will be safe standing on the floor in the back.
Will not be hurt in an accident because they are small.
Must never stand in the vehicle while it is moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must never stand in the vehicle while it is moving.
questions.explanation: Children need special seats designed for their size. No one is strong enough to hold a child safely during an accident or sudden stop. Always use a proper child seat. Never let a child stand or ride without being properly secured.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: You should use cruise control near railroad crossings to keep a steady speed.
You must stop at a railroad crossing if a flagger or stop sign tells you to.
You have the right-of-way at railroad crossings and do not need to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop at a railroad crossing if a flagger or stop sign tells you to.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger, stop sign, or warning signal tells you to. Always be careful when driving near railroad tracks.

questions.question: Roads become very slippery:

options.text: After it has been raining for an hour or more.
The day after it rains.
During the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
Right after the rain stops.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
questions.explanation: Roads are very slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. The water brings oil from the asphalt to the surface. In hot weather, this problem is even worse because heat causes more oil to rise.

questions.question: Check your rearview mirrors:

options.text: Often so you know how traffic is moving behind you.
To see if a vehicle is in your blind spot.
Only when you are slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often so you know how traffic is moving behind you.
questions.explanation: While driving, check your rearview mirrors often. This helps you know where other vehicles are near you.

questions.question: When another vehicle is passing your vehicle, you must:

options.text: Move your vehicle to the right edge of the road without leaving the pavement.
Stay in your lane and keep your speed the same, unless there is an emergency.
Stay in your lane and slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your lane and keep your speed the same, unless there is an emergency.
questions.explanation: When being passed, stay in your lane and keep your speed steady. In an emergency, speed up, slow down, or leave the road to avoid a crash.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road narrows ahead.
A series of curves is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A series of curves is ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns drivers that a winding road is coming.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about driving on wet roads?

options.text: As you drive faster, your tires work less well.
Water does not affect cars with good tires.
Deep water is safer than shallow water.
As you slow down, the road becomes more slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: As you drive faster, your tires work less well.
questions.explanation: When you drive faster on wet roads, your tires cannot wipe away water as well. If you go too fast, your tires lose grip and you hydroplane, or slide on a layer of water.

questions.question: When you want to change lanes, you should never:

options.text: Change lanes while in an intersection.
Check your blind spot by looking over your shoulder.
Check for other drivers moving into the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes while in an intersection.
questions.explanation: Never change lanes in an intersection. Before changing lanes, look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Watch for other drivers moving into the same lane.

questions.question: A steady green light at an intersection means you:

options.text: Must slow down and get ready to stop.
Must stop and check for oncoming traffic before going.
May drive through if the road is clear.
May not turn right.

questions.correctAnswerText: May drive through if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light means you may go through the intersection if it is safe. You can turn right or left on a green light unless a sign says you cannot. When turning, yield to other vehicles and pedestrians.

questions.question: Road markings guide and control traffic. Broken white lines:

options.text: Show that traffic moves both ways.
Separate lanes moving in the same direction.
Show a no passing zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Separate lanes moving in the same direction.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going the same direction. Broken white lines can be crossed carefully.

questions.question: To enter a freeway:

options.text: Signal, yield to traffic already on the freeway, and match the speed of traffic.
Signal and enter. Freeway traffic must yield to you.
Drive slowly so you can check traffic.
Always come to a complete stop first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, yield to traffic already on the freeway, and match the speed of traffic.
questions.explanation: When entering a freeway, signal and match the speed of traffic. Always yield to other vehicles already on the freeway.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a safe driving practice on the interstate?

options.text: Slower traffic stays in the right lane.
Change lanes without signaling.
If you miss your exit, go to the next exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes without signaling.
questions.explanation: Always signal before changing lanes. Stay in the right lane if you are slower than other traffic. Do not back up or make a U-turn on the interstate. If you miss your exit, go to the next one.

questions.question: You must signal every time you pull away from a curb.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: Always use a turn signal when you pull away from a curb.

questions.question: A major cause of rear-end collisions in work zones is:

options.text: One driver going a different speed than other traffic.
Lack of work zone warning signs.
Construction equipment blocking drivers' views.

questions.correctAnswerText: One driver going a different speed than other traffic.
questions.explanation: Driving faster or slower than surrounding traffic causes many rear-end collisions in work zones. Watch traffic around you and obey posted speed limits.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic signal has the same rules as:

options.text: A slow sign.
A yield sign.
A stop sign.
An intersection sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red signal means you must stop and let all other traffic pass before you go.

questions.question: When passing a vehicle on the left, it is safe to move back to the right lane:

options.text: After about three seconds.
When you cannot see the vehicle in your right shoulder mirror.
When you can see the front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see the front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: You can move back to the right lane when the headlights of the passed vehicle appear in your rearview mirror. Always signal before changing lanes.
